sources.note: Nothing. Purely sociolinguistic (domains of use, vitality, attitudes, dialect mapping, 210-item wordlists in Annex D); no phonology chapter; the words stress/accent/tone do not occur. Sec. 1.5 states 'no substantial study has been carried out' on the language; Table 6.3 reports that a phonemic inventory and a dictionary exist in the community (not identified).
